$comment: The looks the golden screen draws (gallery entry looks.golden, `bun run golden:looks`), one per row of the sheet. A look is what a setup carries (docs: theme files, settings, agent-pane/theme.css): `schemes.light` and `schemes.dark` are each a theme file (a repo path in `themeFile`, or its keys inline in `theme`), `settings` are setup settings (agentPane.display.* reach the chat's display push; sidebar.* the window's sidebar), `composerLook` the composer's look, `themeCSS` a repo path of an agent-pane/theme.css. `setup` instead names a setup folder (examples/looks/NAME): its cmux-setup.json settings, its appearance.themeFile under themes/ (for the scheme it is drawn in; the other scheme keeps the default theme under the look's stylesheet) and its agent-pane/theme.css. A look whose files are missing in this checkout is skipped, with the reason in the gallery note. A scheme with no theme draws cmux's default (Apple System Colors and Apple System Colors Light). Settings a checkout does not know yet (agentPane.display.transcriptLook before it lands) are sent and ignored, as the app does.

looks.title: cmux
looks.note: The default: no look installed, the chat and window as cmux draws them today.

looks.title: Claude
looks.note: The built-in Claude look: Claude's composer, the claude transcript preset, the shipped Claude Desktop theme file in light and the Claude Dark theme in dark.

looks.title: Codex
looks.note: The built-in Codex look: Codex's composer, the codex transcript preset, and the Codex app's white and #181818 pages with a blue accent and a slate sidebar.

looks.title: Studio
looks.note: The built-in Studio look: the studio transcript preset over a near-black neutral page (dark) and a zinc-white one (light), compact rows.
